name: Wit of the Crossroad’s Tavern
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area: 10-ft.-radius burst
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Will negates; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

Each enemy within the area of effect takes 2d6 points of Phrenic damage +1 point per caster level . In addition, the target is unable to move from its current space for the spell’s duration. A successful save at the end of the target’s turn negates this immobilization effect.

For the duration of the encounter, you gain the ability to speak and understand any language that the targets who failed their save know. This effect is similar to the tongues spell.
